about_the_game:
"Welcome to Harmonics—bringing you the America of tomorrow today!"



In PUNT, traverse Harmonics' increasingly complex quality assurance program to test and assess the leading industrial innovation of the new millennium: the E.M.M.A. (and Harmonics' equally enigmatic line of compatible cuboid appliances). The Environmental Mass Manipulation Apparatus is an all-in-one, one-man, heavy-duty lifting machine—capable of hurling heavy objects (and her user) across and about once-thought inhuman spectra.

She's not just efficient—she's the E.M.M.A.!

Workshop support is planned post-launch. Stay tuned to experience new puzzles and other unique community-driven experiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Athlon II X4
  • Memory: 4GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: Shader Model 3.0 Compatible GPU, DirectX 9.0c
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 32 bit operating systems are not recommended or tested, and we will not offer support for those platforms. Proton compatibility is planned but may not be functional at launch.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600K or AMD Ryzen 1600
  • Memory: 4GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: Shader Model 3.0 Compatible GPU, DirectX 9.0c
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 32 bit operating systems are not recommended or tested, and we will not offer support for those platforms. Proton compatibility is planned but may not be functional at launch.

short_description: Discover the abilities of the E.M.M.A. in this new and innovative first-person puzzle platformer running on the Source Engine.
